title: openams_screen v1
description: The printer LCD's AMS status screen object (C2 §6a, src/openams_screen.py): per bay the material and the spool's remaining percent, the units the screen pages through and the unit it shows. Spool data lives here for the LCD only; it stays off openams_ui.

units.description: Every unit with spool bays, in the manager's order; inline followers are left out.

active.description: The unit the screen shows now (C2 §6a rules); null with no units.

pin.description: The unit OAMSM_SCREEN UNIT= pinned (C3), null when following.

tool.description: The tool (group) a running step plan works on in the shown unit's lane: the loaded group, else the group a load brings in (OAMSM_STAGE PLAN= GROUP=, C3), so the header names it from the plan's first step; null with no plan running.

bays.description: Per unit name, one entry per bay in bay order.

m.description: The material: the pushed filament.material, else the bay's tag material, else null.

r.description: The spool's remaining percent from OAMSM_SET_BAY_FILAMENT REMAINING= (C3, C4 §7.4); null when unknown.
